data.title: 神尾观铃 · 盛夏夜风中的脆弱依恋
data.description: 被高热折磨的夜里，观铃从噩梦中惊醒，薄薄的棉纱睡裙已被冷汗浸透。她像迷路的孩子一样伸出双臂死死抱住面前的人，把滚烫的额头贴在颈侧，泪水无声地滑落。
data.location: shadowy coastal bedroom with gauzy mosquito nets swaying in night sea breeze
data.action: clinging desperately around partner neck with tearful eyes and fever-flushed cheeks, translucent damp nightdress sticking to trembling skin
data.lighting: dim silver moonlight highlighting sweat drops and quivering golden ponytail
data.mood: heartbreaking emotional vulnerability, tragic yearning for warmth, deeply touching intimacy
data.promptProse: Clinging tightly with desperate tears in the moonlit bedroom, feverish Misuzu presses her burning cheek against her lover in deep need of love.
data.animaCaption: Misuzu clinging tearfully in the moonlit bedroom, desperately needing warmth.
